title: Visiting Researcher
subtitle: FORTH – Institute of Computer Science · Heraklion, Greece · Apr–Jun 2026 · Supervisor: Vangelis Sakkalis
description: Research design and technical groundwork for a multimodal ML monitoring project on idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and RA-associated interstitial lung disease. Co-developed a pipeline for reconstructing corrupted biosignal recordings, designed a multi-task extension of the PULSE model for wearable PPG data, and refactored a MIMIC-IV data pipeline into a working training baseline.

title: Research Collaboration on EEG Signal Reconstruction

description: Evaluating the robustness of hvEEGNet, a deep learning model for reconstructing corrupted EEG signals, under noise and artifacts.
